text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The race is so incredible, none of us
remember to
even breathe.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The moment Fuji Kiseki flies past the
finish line
and claims first place, the
stands ring with cries of
jubilation.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Yeeeaaahhh! She did it! That was
amazing!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Fan Club Member A
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, Fuji! We're so
unbelievably
proud of you, congraaats!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Fan Club Member B
text_block_list.text: Thank you for the miracle! Sniff!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Her audience of thousands hung onto
her every
word.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Her every breath and movement was like
that of a
dream to them.

text_block_list.name: Fuji's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"Now burn the image of my form upon
those
beautiful eyes of yours, dark and
deep as the
night!"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: It's that same sight...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
(Calm down. I must remain an
entertainer until
the very end!)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Fuji Kiseki closes her eyes softly and
bows her
head reverentially to the
stands.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I'm incredibly humbled to have the
honor of
receiving such a love-filled
standing ovation.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
This is the end of the miracles for my
senior year,
and it's time for the actors
to return to the wings
of the stage.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
But please, worry not! My tale is not yet
over!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She spreads her hands wide, and a single
firework
shoots into the sky and blooms.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Oooooh!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
My miracle today will continue on into
the future,
and I promise to bring it to
you all!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Goodbye for now! Be well, everyone!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She exits her stage, leaving behind the
twinkling
sky, and everyone sees her off
with eyes full of
admiration.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: And thus concludes chapter one.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Trainer? I know it in my heart, but I still
want to
hear you say it.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Do you think I was able to become the
greatest
entertainer ever?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The audience's cheers for Fuji Kiseki are just as passionate—no, they're even more passionate than the applause her mother received in the play we once watched together.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...I'm so happy. If you say so, it must be
true.
choice_data_list: 君は最高のエンターテイナーだ
貴方は最高のエンターテイナーだよ

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...There's something I want to get off my
chest.
Please pay it no mind, but...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
The truth is, a part of me never forgave
my
younger self.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
The me who failed to achieve true
acclaim on the
stage just couldn't let
things go.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
So, no matter how many times I won, I
still didn't
believe in myself.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Even as I continued down the path of
racing, my
younger self was always
there.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
But right now, I feel like I can finally
forgive her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Fuji Kiseki's mouth curves into a small,
shy smile.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
This is my path... No, that's not it. This is
where I
belong.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The ruby sunset illuminates the profile of
her face
as she speaks.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She turns away from me abruptly before
I have a
chance to say anything.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Well, we can't spend forever wallowing
in
sentimentality!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
The end is just another beginning. Let's
start
working toward our next show!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Together, we can go anywhere.
